name: 37813-prefillheavy-qwen35moe35b-2gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, bf16, unquantized, public and ungated, ~67 GiB of weights across 14 shards.
hardware: 2x H100 80GB HBM3 (two GPUs of one a3 node, --gres=gpu:2).
parallelism: TP=2, PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine; the weights plus the per-sequence state pool at 256-way concurrency do not fit one 80 GiB card.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=256, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 1000 requests with an 1800 s safety cap. Seed static 37813.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`: 1024 prompt tokens and 20 output tokens per request, min == max == mean on both, temperature 0, prefix caching off.
purpose: A document-analysis assistant for enterprise teams, returning brief answers to page-length prompts at 256 concurrent streams on two GPUs.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B

# The checkpoint carries a vision tower; this drops it, so the served model is the text stack alone.
language-model-only: true

tensor-parallel-size: 2
max-num-seqs: 256
max-model-len: 4096
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: false
